data.title: 伊内丝 · 演出前的停顿
data.description: 她在镜前整理领口，透过镜面看向你。听完你的评价，伊内丝稍稍偏过头，嘴角终于有了一点笑意。
data.action: 扶镜回眸，指尖整理领口
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Inside a backstage dressing room with glowing marquee bulbs, Ines sits at a vanity table, adjusting her collar while glancing back at the viewer through the mirror with a slight, subtle smile. Makeup palettes, brushes, and performance garments on the dressing table are reflected in the large vanity mirror.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the backstage vanity framed by glowing marquee bulbs, she lifts one hand to adjust her collar and catches the viewer's eye in the mirror with a slight smile. Makeup palettes and brushes line the lit counter before her.
